requirements: Monkey Madness I begins after The Grand Tree and Tree Gnome Village, with no numeric skill requirement in the pinned helper. It requires defeating a level-195 Jungle Demon and navigating Ape Atoll prison/dungeon.

RFD King Awowogei needs the Monkey Madness I completion and the Recipe for Disaster banquet opening (Another Cook's Quest). Its 48 Agility check is not boostable; its 70 Cooking check is boostable at the stuffed-snake cooking stage.

MM I uses a gold bar, ball of wool, regular Karamjan monkey bones, dentures, m'amulet mould, bananas, talisman and food. RFD requires three distinct monkey bone varieties and talismans, the retained MM I amulet and Karamjan greegree, rope, knife, pestle and mortar, red banana, Tchiki paste and Big Snake corpse.

observations.monkey_madness_i: Narnode sends player to Karamja shipyard, then Daero's glider puzzle and Crash Island. An initial capture leads to Garkor, hidden dentures and mould, Zooknock's enchanted gold, temple flame amulet, monkey-child bananas/talisman and normal Karamjan bones, a greegree, Awowogei's alliance talks, the Ardougne Zoo monkey, Garkor's squad sigil and Jungle Demon fight.
observations.monkey_madness_i_rewards: Completion awards 3 QP, 10,000 coins, 3 diamonds, Ape Atoll access and Dragon scimitar eligibility. Daero offers an optional later mutually exclusive training bundle: 35,000 XP each in Attack/Defence and 20,000 each in Strength/Hitpoints, or vice versa. These are two conditional reward-claim actions with one shared claim flag.
observations.rfd_awowogei: The frozen king requests his favourite food. Real Awowogei and three wise monkeys reject ordinary banana and nuts. After obtaining gorilla/ninja/zombie greegrees through Zooknock, use 48 Agility to reach red banana, get Tchiki nuts and grind paste, retrieve Big Snake corpse from Crash Island, stuff and cook at underground coals while in zombie disguise, and give cooked snake to frozen king.
observations.rfd_rewards: Completion awards 1 QP, 10,000 Cooking XP and 10,000 Agility XP, Ape Atoll Teleport and further Culinaromancer chest access. The parent Recipe for Disaster quest receives no duplicate XP.
observations.travel: Directed reversible connections for glider, Lumdo boat, Ape Atoll lanes/prison, Monkey temple and Zooknock dungeon, Ardougne Zoo, monkey cave, RFD frozen banquet and hot coals. Glider and palace approaches are gated by relevant quest progress.
observations.execution: All new source and catalog records remain draft and independent review is required. No generator, saved-example hash or dataset version edits until integration.
